# FDG4046

> CONSIDER providing special enum values for commonly used combinations of flags.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.8.1 Designing Flag Enums.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: draft

Which combinations are commonly used is a design judgment; not machine-checkable.

## From the book

Bitwise operations are an advanced concept and should not be required for simple tasks. `FileAccess.ReadWrite` is an example of such a special value.

```csharp
[Flags]
public enum FileAccess {
   Read = 1,
   Write = 2,
   ReadWrite = Read | Write
}
```
